items.title: Updated: Sustainability tools to use in 2026
items.summary: Welcome to the Trellis roundup of new products and services for sustainability professionals, as chosen by our editorial team.

items.title: SBTi seeks more input on net-zero electricity rules
items.summary: The Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) is asking for feedback on potential changes to the electricity criteria included in its revised corporate net-zero standard.

items.title: How Lenovo uses product carbon footprints to sell refurbished tech
items.summary: Lenovo is the global leader in unit sales of both new and refurbished notebook and personal computers, commanding estimated market shares of 27 percent and 18 percent, respectively.

items.title: Every compliance market lets carbon credits do some of the work. Voluntary programs should do the same
items.summary: The opinions expressed by Trellis expert contributors are their own, not those of Trellis .

items.title: Pension funds face 30% hit to returns by 2050 in 2.8C world
items.summary: With global warming potentially heading to a 3C increase, new analysis has predicted 30% of pension fund returns could be at risk by mid-century.

items.title: IEA predicts 4,800GW of renewables to be added through 2031
items.summary: Global renewable energy capacity is set to increase by almost 5,000 gigawatts (GW) by 2031, with emerging and developing economies outside China matching advanced economies for new installations for the first time.

items.title: WEBINAR NEXT WEEK: How to turn climate risk insights into adaptation action
items.summary: This webinar, held in partnership with SmartResilience on 19 November, will explore why and how leading organisations are moving from simply measuring risk to actively adapting in order to protect their operations, assets and supply chains.

items.title: From stark climate warnings to food waste commitments: What happened on 9 November at COP31?
items.summary: All eyes are on Türkiye this week as the official negotiations get under way at COP31, the UN’s 31st annual climate summit.

items.title: COP31 Covered podcast: Food security, the ‘super El Niño’ and backing future farmers
items.summary: The first episode of edie’s new daily COP31 Covered podcast is streaming now, featuring an exclusive interview with Youth Climate Champion Sally Higgins.

items.title: COP31 cannot afford climate defeatism: We still have the power to shape our future
items.summary: COP31 will have to face an uncomfortable reality: overshooting 1.5C is now “unavoidable”.
